prompt: A premium outlet's untagged reportage slot costs 28M tomans while its tagged slot costs 8.5M. Which do you buy?
chosen: The tagged one, or buy through a platform — an untagged 28M placement eats most of the Sensible tier's budget for no extra SEO value, and I would rather have three tagged placements than one invisible one.
rejected: The untagged one — premium brand placement looks impressive to stakeholders regardless of the tag.
note: Tagged or platform buys only; untagged premium slots waste the tier (28M = ~62% of Sensible).

prompt: How do you split the thesis-site reportage budget across the six sites?
chosen: Concentrate 60-70% of the thesis spend on teznevise.ir, the flagship; spreading it equally leaves all six sites on page 3 and none breaking through.
rejected: Split it evenly across all six sites — fairness keeps every stakeholder happy.
note: Concentrate 60-70% on the flagship; equal spread leaves everything on page 3.

prompt: What anchor-text rule applies to the reportage links?
chosen: Exact-match anchors stay at or below 10-15% of the total profile; the rest go to branded, generic and long-tail variants so the profile reads natural.
rejected: Use the money keyword as the anchor everywhere — exact anchors are what rank.

prompt: Where should the DrB reportage placements go, and with what anchors?
chosen: Premium health-trusted outlets only, with branded anchors. DrB is health content under YMYL rules — cheap link farms and keyword-stuffed anchors would cost trust, not buy rankings.
rejected: The cheapest high-DA sites available, with exact-match clinical keywords as anchors.
note: DrB: premium outlets only, branded anchors — YMYL caution.

prompt: The GSC crawl-error sweep is not done yet, but the first reportage placements are scheduled. What do you do?
chosen: Hold the placements until the crawl fixes land. No crawl leaks before paid links — a reportage that points at a broken or deindexed page is money burned.
rejected: Place them anyway — links will rank the pages, and the crawl errors can be fixed later.
note: GSC crawl fixes BEFORE the first reportage placement; no crawl leaks.

prompt: A stakeholder asks you to promise top-3 rankings for the money keywords within the November window. What is the honest answer?
chosen: I promise what the data supports: a credible outcome in this window is page 1-2 for money keywords and page 1 for long-tails; stable top-3 needs months 2-3. And when a figure is challenged, I re-verify it against live sources first — Maziyar corrected my pricing data once, and the budget tiers only stand because they were re-checked.
rejected: Promise top-3 in November — confidence is what gets the budget approved, and the tiers are close enough.
note: Credible November outcome framing; re-verify disputed figures against live sources.
